skill.name: git-pr-workflows-onboard
skill.description: Creates structured onboarding plans, checklists, and milestone workflows for new team members in technical organizations.
skill.summary: Build onboarding plans for technical teams from pre-start preparation through 90-day milestones.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Technical onboarding often fails when access, learning paths, and milestones are scattered across teams. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce structured plans, checklists, and 30/60/90 day workflows.
actual_capabilities: Builds pre-start, Day 1, Week 1, and 30/60/90 day onboarding plans.
Creates role-specific checklists for engineers, senior leads, and remote employees.
Organizes access setup, documentation review, buddy support, and milestone tracking.
Suggests feedback loops, success metrics, and manager check-in structures.
Adapts onboarding activities for remote, hybrid, and on-site team contexts.
limitations: Does not create accounts, grant permissions, or verify access automatically.
Requires team-specific details to produce a precise onboarding plan.
Does not replace HR, legal, security, or manager review.
May need updates for organization-specific tools and policies.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Engineer Start
use_cases.description: Create a first-week and 90-day plan for a software engineer joining a product team.

use_cases.title: Standardize Remote Onboarding
use_cases.description: Build a repeatable workflow for remote employees across time zones and distributed teams.

use_cases.title: Accelerate Senior Hire Ramp-Up
use_cases.description: Prepare an accelerated plan for a senior engineer or lead who must assess systems quickly.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Onboarding Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a basic plan when only the role and start date are known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple onboarding plan for a new [role] starting on [date]. Include pre-start tasks, Day 1 activities, Week 1 goals, and 30/60/90 day milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Role-Specific Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Adapt onboarding for tools, team structure, and technical expectations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a role-specific onboarding checklist for a [level] [role] on the [team] team. Include access needs, documentation, first code contribution, buddy support, and manager check-ins.

prompt_templates.title: Remote Team Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Design onboarding for distributed teams with async collaboration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a remote onboarding workflow for a [role] in [time zones]. Include communication norms, async rituals, equipment preparation, team introductions, and feedback checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Program Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing onboarding program using metrics and feedback loops.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this onboarding process: [paste process]. Identify gaps, propose measurable improvements, and produce a revised 90-day plan with ownership, success metrics, and risk controls.

output_examples.input: A mid-level backend engineer starts in two weeks on a remote platform team.
output_examples.output: A staged onboarding plan with pre-start access tasks, Day 1 orientation, Week 1 codebase sessions, first PR goals, buddy check-ins, and 30/60/90 day milestones.

output_examples.input: A senior engineer needs accelerated onboarding for a complex system migration.
output_examples.output: An accelerated four-week ramp plan covering architecture reviews, stakeholder meetings, postmortem review, technical assessment, quick wins, and ownership milestones.

output_examples.input: A people operations team wants one checklist for remote technical hires.
output_examples.output: A reusable remote onboarding checklist for equipment, account setup, communication norms, team introductions, training modules, feedback surveys, and manager checkpoints.

best_practices: Provide role, start date, location, team structure, and required tools before asking for a plan.
Review generated access and security tasks with HR, IT, and security owners before use.
Convert the plan into owned checklist items with dates, reviewers, and success criteria.
anti_patterns: Using one generic onboarding plan for every role and seniority level.
Treating generated checklists as permission to grant access without approval.
Skipping feedback loops after the first week of onboarding.

faq.question: What kind of onboarding does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports technical employee onboarding, especially for engineers, senior technical hires, and remote team members.

faq.question: Can it create a 30/60/90 day plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure milestones, expected outcomes, feedback sessions, and contribution goals across the first 90 days.

faq.question: Does it grant access to systems?
faq.answer: No. It only helps plan access tasks. Approved administrators must create accounts and grant permissions.

faq.question: Can it be used for remote onboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for async communication, time zones, virtual introductions, and remote equipment preparation.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide the role, level, team, location, start date, tools, technical stack, and any special ramp-up needs.

faq.question: Is it only for software engineers?
faq.answer: No. It is strongest for technical teams, but the structure can support other knowledge-worker onboarding plans.
